name: cs16-admin
description: Live management tab for Counter-Strike 1.6 servers: chat feed, live players with SteamID, rounds and scores, kick, ban, map control, cvars and quick admin actions.
author: Catalyst Team

defaultBanMinutes.description: Default ban length in minutes applied when the admin leaves duration empty (0 = permanent)

useAmx.description: Prefer AMX Mod X commands (amx_kick, amx_ban, amx_map) when available, with vanilla fallback

chatHistoryLimit.description: Maximum chat lines kept in the live feed per server tab

writeBansFile.description: Also append permanent bans to cstrike/banned.cfg via the file tunnel (off by default)

cs16-admin:player-banned.description: An admin banned a player through the CS 1.6 tab

cs16-admin:player-kicked.description: An admin kicked a player through the CS 1.6 tab

cs16-admin:map-changed.description: An admin changed the map through the CS 1.6 tab

cs16-admin:command-sent.description: An admin sent a validated console command through the CS 1.6 tab
